name: Submit a Fable 5.5 video
description: Suggest a video for the list
title: "Add: "
labels: ["new video"]
body:
  - type: input
    id: post
    attributes:
      label: Link to the post
      description: The post where the author shares the video and says Fable 5.5 made it.
      placeholder: https://x.com/...
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: prompt
    attributes:
      label: Prompt (optional)
      description: The exact prompt, if the author published it, with a link to where.
  - type: checkboxes
    id: checks
    attributes:
      label: Checks
      options:
        - label: The author says in their own post that Fable 5.5 made this video.
          required: true
        - label: It is not a side-by-side comparison of several models.
          required: true
